ModMetaData.name: VQE Ancients - Archogen Injector Whitelist
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description:
Choose which genes Vanilla Quests Expanded - Ancients' archogen injector can give.
The archogen injector rewards a pawn with a random archite gene and saddles them with a random side-effect gene, and the Ancients' experiment pawns are generated the same way. Both are picked from every loaded gene mod, so with a big gene list the reward can be any other mod's archite gene and the side effect can be almost anything.
With this mod only a curated default list can be rolled: Ancients' own archite genes as the reward, and a set of real drawback genes as side effects. Every gene the injector could give is listed in the mod settings with a search box and a tick box per gene, so you can allow more or remove ones the defaults allow. Changes apply straight away; no restart needed.
The default list is an XML def (ArchogenInjectorWhitelist.InjectionWhitelistDef), so other mods can add their own list or patch this one.
Originally part of Too Many Mods - Compats and Rebalances by Warachia.
